items.content_html: LocalKB is a lightweight, self-hosted knowledge base. It takes your .txt, .md, and .pdf files, breaks them into chunks, generates embeddings with Ollama, and stores them as binary vectors (BLOBs) in SQLite. Retrieval uses SQLite’s FTS5 search for speed, then cosine similarity re-ranking for accuracy.
